Thanks Mina —

Appreciate the materials. Quick answers inline:

- Signatory entity: Putnam Analytics, Inc., Delaware.
- Target billing start: July 1, 2027 (internal deadline is end of June).
- Residency: primary data center is us-east-1; we do process EU customer data under customer direction. Don’t think a separate EU hosting carve-out is required but will confirm.
- DPA: Yes, we need a DPA attached. Our commercial/legal team typically provides a standard DPA and asks for a couple of cross-references in the MSA.

We can aim for a first-pass from Putnam Legal by end of day Thu (27 May). Erin will shepherd comments.
